variants.exp53: No pooled context; envelope-guided decoding enabled. Not a pure single-component ablation vs exp55.
variants.exp54: Pooled context with fixed 0.5 output averaging; envelope-guided decoding enabled. Not a pure single-component ablation vs exp55.
variants.exp56: Uses only the final local block output before context; hierarchy compression remains.
variants.exp57: Simple 1x1 spatial projection instead of residual spatial adapter.

runner_notes: Input tensor shape is (batch, input_channels, time).
All variants return envelope, mel, aux_envelopes, and aux_mels.
exp53 and exp54 additionally return gate.
Pooled-context variants use pool size 8 and require valid avg_pool1d input length.
